blocks.title: Graph
blocks.text: A graph is a data structure made of nodes (vertices) connected by edges. Graph algorithms explore and analyze graphs and are essential for network analysis, route planning and social network analysis.

blocks.prompt: In a road map drawn as a graph, what are the nodes and edges?
blocks.explanation: Nodes are places such as cities or junctions; edges are the roads joining them.

items: Graph: nodes (vertices) joined by edges; used in networks, routes and social networks.
